elements.requirement: The Secretary of State may by order made by statutory instrument make provision in consequence of the Consumer Rights Act 2015.
elements.quote: The Secretary of State may by order made by statutory instrument make provision in consequence of this Act.

elements.requirement: The Secretary of State's power to make consequential orders includes the power to amend, repeal, revoke or otherwise modify any provision made by an enactment or an instrument made under an enactment, including an enactment passed or instrument made in the same Session as the Consumer Rights Act 2015.
elements.quote: to amend, repeal, revoke or otherwise modify any provision made by an enactment or an instrument made under an enactment (including an enactment passed or instrument made in the same Session as this Act)

elements.requirement: The Secretary of State's power to make consequential orders includes the power to make transitional, transitory or saving provision.
elements.quote: to make transitional, transitory or saving provision.

elements.requirement: A statutory instrument containing (whether alone or with other provision) an order under section 96 that amends, repeals, revokes or otherwise modifies any provision of primary legislation must not be made unless a draft of the instrument has been laid before, and approved by a resolution of, each House of Parliament.
elements.quote: is not to be made unless a draft of the instrument has been laid before, and approved by a resolution of, each House of Parliament.

elements.requirement: A statutory instrument containing an order under section 96 that does not amend, repeal, revoke or otherwise modify any provision of primary legislation is subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of either House of Parliament.
elements.quote: is subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of either House of Parliament.

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 96, an 'enactment' includes an Act of the Scottish Parliament, a Measure or Act of the National Assembly for Wales, and Northern Ireland legislation.
elements.quote: “enactment” includes an Act of the Scottish Parliament, a Measure or Act of the National Assembly for Wales and Northern Ireland legislation

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 96, 'primary legislation' means an Act of Parliament, an Act of the Scottish Parliament, a Measure or Act of the National Assembly for Wales, and Northern Ireland legislation.
elements.quote: “primary legislation” means— an Act of Parliament,an Act of the Scottish Parliament,a Measure or Act of the National Assembly for Wales, andNorthern Ireland legislation.
